title: Digital PALPA Language Assessment
summary: A student project with Herzfeld Medical Center that moves PALPA language tests and other assessment tools from binders to the iPad.
description:
In a student project with **Herzfeld Medical Center**, we developed an app for the clinical team that brings their assessment questionnaires to the iPad and lets them build custom language-diagnosis tests.

Clinicians give the tests to patients directly on the iPad. There are no binders or paperwork, and every result is saved digitally.

## Next steps
The data collected will be used for advanced analysis and to develop a **decision-support system**. It will help the medical team with diagnosis and with choosing the best test battery for each patient.

The tests are built with the questionnaire and test builder of [DMT – Proms++](/projects/dmt-proms).
